subject: Mathematics
summary: Pair 3 (Even/Odd Investigation) clears the bar. The expanded_walkthrough now cites Ross 1989 (place-value digit-by-digit) and NCTM number trajectories, and recovery_moves branches into three diagnostics (A: can't justify rule -> physical pair-test; B: stalls on 3-digit -> ones-place rule; C: zero-as-even confusion -> empty-pile demo) -- a clear Level 4 on pedagogical_depth and mathematical_authenticity. Detective Ona Ones anchors minds_on and the exit refrain 'Pair them UP -- leftover DOWN! Even, even, ODD!' is quotable and chanted 3x. Worksheet 3 title 'Detective Ona's Even/Odd Probe' is trimmed and matches lesson worksheet_brief; three parts map to the three success criteria with the Part-3 odd-start skip-count as a transfer-task variation. Instructional_balance lands at 3 (achieving): puppet is explicitly OPTIONAL with substitutions, time is realistic (12/25/13 = 50 min for G2), but the differentiation block does not name a no-paper/no-purchase body-or-voice-only alternative path that would push to Level 4. Acceptable as the single 3 under the strict bar.
